title: Chicken & Mushroom Marsala

items.item: chopped flat-leaf parsley or chives, plus more for garnish

instructions: Place the chicken in a single layer on a cutting board, cover with plastic wrap, and pound lightly using the flat end of a meat mallet until the tenderloins are ¼-inch thick.
Stir together the flour, ½ tsp salt, and ½ tsp pepper in a wide, shallow bowl.

Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Dip the chicken pieces into the flour mixture, turning to coat both sides, shake off the excess flour, and place in the heated skillet. Cook 3 minutes on each side, until golden and cooked through. Remove from the skillet and keep warm.

Add the mushrooms to the skillet and sauté over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, until the water has evaporated and the mushrooms are browned. Add the garlic and cook briefly until fragrant. Season with the remaining 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper. Add the 1/2 cup dry marsala wine. Add the chicken stock and simmer for 5 minutes, until the sauce reduces slightly.

In a small bowl, whisk flour with water until smooth, then stir the mixture into the skillet and simmer until the sauce thickens. Return the chicken to the pan and simmer gently for 1 minute to heat through.
Garnish with parsley or chives before serving.
